per_skip.skip: exons 54-55 (2 exons, 345 bp, del aa 2625-2739, junction ACAGAAACCAAG|GACCTCCAAGGT)
per_skip.published_asos: Exon 55: Ex55_Ac0_30-mer PMO TCTTCCAAAGCAGCCTCTCGCTCACTCACC (acceptor-spanning) and hEx55_Ac83_25-mer GCAGTTGTTTCAGCTTCTGTAAGCC (Echigoya 2019, PMID 31416775/PMC6838919); Nippon Shinyaku/NCNP patent US20180142245A1 oligomers H55_8-28, H55_11-31, H55_14-34 (nt 1-34 from exon-55 5' end), 2'OMe-PS/morpholino ~21-mers, reported high-efficiency exon 55 skipping. Exon 54: Ex54_Ac42_30-mer GAGAAGTTTCAGGGCCAAGTCATTTGCCAC and hEx54_Ac22_25-mer GCCACATCTACATTTGTCTGCCACT (same paper). Wilton 2007 (PMID 17285139) built a panel covering every internal exon incl. 54 and 55; all targeted exons were removable though efficiencies differed.
per_skip.coordinated_skipping: POSITIVE and unique to this block: 'directing an AO to human dystrophin exon 54 led to removal of both exons 54 + 55' (Wilton-group rational-design paper, PMC2835229). Stated in Discussion with no AO name, sequence, cell type or efficiency given; an earlier secondary web summary of the same claim said exon-54-only and 54+55 products arose in roughly equal amounts, which I could not confirm in the retrieved text. Supporting mechanism from the same paper: H53A(+39+69) gave both exon-53 and a substantial exon-53+54 skipped species in mouse cells. Searches returning nothing: PubMed 'single antisense oligonucleotide induced skipping of two adjacent exons dystrophin unexpected co-skipping' (0), 'dystrophin exon skipping ASO induced skipping of the adjacent exon in addition to the target exon' (0), 'dystrophin exon 53 exon 54 ASO skipping both exons cocktail screening' (0); Europe PMC HTTP 503 on all queries.
per_skip.linked_or_multitarget: Brogidirsen / NS-089/NCNP-02: single PMO with a 'connected-sequence' (dual-targeting) design joining two separate target sequences inside exon 44 to block two splicing regulators at once; highest skipping of the series, active in patient cells and in cynomolgus skeletal and cardiac muscle; in clinical phase 1/2 (NCT05996003). Aartsma-Rus 2006 (PMID 16753346): double targeting within one exon improved efficiency and rescued the previously 'unskippable' exons 47 and 57.
per_skip.amenability: Exon 54 is the amenable member of the pair: one AO against it reportedly removes 54+55 (PMC2835229), and Ex54_Ac42_30-mer scored 62.0% predicted skipping. Exon 55 falls in the '5'Fast-3'Fast' flanking-intron class, and exons with a fast 5'-flanking intron are significantly less skippable; targeting nearer the exon 5'-end is more efficient (PMC10481881) - consistent with both independent exon-55 lead sets (H55 nt 1-34; Ex55_Ac0 acceptor-spanning) sitting at the 5' end. Endogenous multiple-exon-skipping in normal muscle uses donors at the 3' ends of exons 41/44/47/49 and acceptors at the 5' ends of exons 56/58/60/61 only (PMC5085753); neither an exon-54 donor nor an exon-55 acceptor is a natural re-join point, so there is no natural 54-55 bypass to recruit. No natural/endogenous exon-55 skipping rate was found. Critical frame risk: exon-54-only or exon-55-only products are both out of frame, so partial skipping yields no protein, not less protein.

findings.claim: 'Directing an AO to human dystrophin exon 54 led to removal of both exons 54 + 55.'
H53A(+39+69) in mouse cells gave exon-53 and a substantial exon-53+54 skipped transcript; dual-skip never seen in human cells with it.
Exon 55 PMO Ex55_Ac0_30-mer TCTTCCAAAGCAGCCTCTCGCTCACTCACC, predicted skipping 120.4%; exon 54 Ex54_Ac42_30-mer 62.0%.
Patent claims exon-55-skipping oligomers targeting nt 1-21, 11-31, 14-34 from the exon 55 5' end (H55_8-28, H55_11-31, H55_14-34).
Exon 55 is classified 5'Fast-3'Fast; fast 5'-flanking introns correlate with lower skipping efficiency; 5'-end targeting beats 3'-end.
Brogidirsen is a single ASO combining two targeting sequences within exon 44, the highest-skipping oligomer of its screen.

per_skip.skip: exons 55-56 (2 exons, 363 bp, del aa 2676-2796, junction CATTCATAAAAG|GTCCCATTTGGA)
per_skip.published_asos: Exon 55: as above (Ex55_Ac0_30-mer, hEx55_Ac83_25-mer, H55_8-28/11-31/14-34). Exon 56: no human exon-56 ASO sequence or efficiency found. Wilton 2007 (PMID 17285139) states a panel was designed against every internal exon and every targeted exon could be removed, which implies an exon-56 AO exists in that panel, but I could not retrieve its name, sequence or efficiency (cell.com and ScienceDirect both returned 403). Li/Wilton 2020 (PMC7516190) skipped exons 56+57 in vivo, but in the mouse Dmd transcript and with one PMO per exon; sequences are supplementary-only and were not retrieved.
per_skip.coordinated_skipping: None found. No report of one oligo skipping 55+56. Searches tried: web 'single antisense oligonucleotide induced skipping of exons 54 and 55 OR exons 55 and 56 dystrophin double skipping one oligo' (returned only cocktail/dual-targeting-within-one-exon work); web/PubMed '"exon 56" DMD antisense oligonucleotide skipping morpholino design nonsense exon 55'; PubMed '"double exon skipping" dystrophin antisense single oligonucleotide in-frame' (1 hit, theoretical applicability only); Europe PMC 503. Negative control from the closest paper: Li/Wilton 2020's exons 56+57 and 58+59 double skips each required a separate PMO per exon - 'No single PMO successfully skipped two exons simultaneously.'
per_skip.linked_or_multitarget: Same precedents as the 54-55 block: brogidirsen connected-sequence single ASO (two arms, one exon) and Aartsma-Rus double-targeting-within-one-exon. No precedent found for one linked molecule with arms in two different exons.
per_skip.amenability: Exon 56 is the strongest natural re-join acceptor in this whole region: the 5' end of exon 56 is one of only four acceptor sites used in endogenous multiple-exon skipping of normal human muscle, and the exon 44-56 junction is the headline natural product (PMC5085753) - so the splicing machinery demonstrably tolerates exon 56 as the downstream partner of a long skip. Counterpoint: endogenous MES products run ~600-fold below full-length mRNA, so this is permissiveness, not a usable baseline. Exon 56 amenability to an ASO in the human transcript is unmeasured in what I retrieved. Genotype-phenotype correlation downstream of exon 55 is explicitly described as lacking because such deletions are rare, so the functional quality of a del55-56 dystrophin is less well anchored than del54-55 (PMC7516190). Exon 55 amenability as in the 54-55 block.

findings.claim: Only four acceptor sites participate in endogenous multi-exon skipping: the 5' ends of exons 56, 58, 60 and 61.
Endogenous MES products sit ~600-fold below full-length DMD mRNA (~12 extra PCR cycles to detect).
Exons 56+57 and 58+59 double skips in vivo each used one PPMO per exon; no single PMO skipped two exons.
Genotype-phenotype correlations downstream of DMD exon 55 are lacking; amenability of this region is stated to be unknown.
Wilton 2007 designed AOs to induce skipping of every exon except the first and last; all targeted exons were removable, efficiencies varied.

per_skip.skip: exons 52-55 (4 exons, 675 bp, del aa 2515-2739, junction ATCAAGCAGAAG|GACCTCCAAGGT)
per_skip.published_asos: All four exons have validated PMOs from the 45-55 cocktail work (PMID 31416775): Ex52_Ac24_30-mer GGTAATGAGTTCTTCCAACTGGGGACGCCT (90.1% predicted); Ex53_Ac9_30-mer GTTCTTGTACTTCATCCCACTGATTCTGAA (73.9%), Ex53_Ac26_30-mer CCTCCGGTTCTGAAGGTGTTCTTGTACTTC (75.2%), hEx53_Ac43_25-mer ATTCAACTGTTGCCTCCGGTTCTGA (7.3%); Ex54_Ac42_30-mer (62.0%); Ex55_Ac0_30-mer (120.4%). Exon 53 also has two approved clinical ASOs (golodirsen, viltolarsen) - chemistry/delivery precedent only, not an efficiency expectation for a 4-exon block.
per_skip.coordinated_skipping: None found for any single oligo spanning this block. Relevant partial precedent only: Aartsma-Rus 2006 achieved multi-exon skipping across exons 45-51 with just TWO AONs aimed at the outer exons (45 and 51), but attempts to extend outer-exon-only targeting to longer stretches including exons 42-55 and 45-59 failed (PMID 16753346). The exon-54 single-AO 54+55 co-skip (PMC2835229) is the only intra-block coordinated event found and it covers 2 of the 4 exons. Searches tried: PubMed 'dystrophin exon 52 exon 55 two antisense oligonucleotides skip intervening exons 52-55 in-frame' (0); 'multiexon skipping targeting outer exons two antisense oligonucleotides dystrophin exons 45-51 intervening exons removed' (0); Europe PMC 503.
per_skip.linked_or_multitarget: Outer-exon-only two-AON multi-exon skipping (exons 45-51) is the only architecture precedent for covering intervening exons without targeting them (PMID 16753346); it broke down for longer stretches. Cocktail architecture is the established alternative: 10-11 PMOs for exons 45-55 in immortalized patient cells and in hDMD mice (PMID 31416775), and systemic Vivo-PMO cocktails in mdx52 (PMID 22869723, PMID 30171548). Brogidirsen shows a single molecule can carry two linked antisense arms.
per_skip.amenability: Best-in-region per-exon numbers: exon 52 (90.1%) and exon 53 (75.2%) are the two most efficiently skipped exons of the block, exon 54 mid (62.0%), exon 55 the kinetically unfavourable one (fast 5' intron). Exon 52's 3' end is NOT one of the four endogenous MES donors (41/44/47/49) and exon 55's 5' end is not an endogenous acceptor, so this specific junction has no natural precedent (PMC5085753). Practical risk flagged by the cocktail papers themselves: PMO cocktails generate a ladder of intermediate transcripts, in-frame and out-of-frame, so a 4-exon block needs the full block to dominate to be productive.

findings.claim: Two AONs against the outer exons 45 and 51 sufficed for exons 45-51 multi-skipping; extension to 42-55 and 45-59 did not work.
Exon 52 PMO Ex52_Ac24_30-mer predicted 90.1%; exon 53 Ex53_Ac26_30-mer 75.2%.
PMO cocktails produced various intermediate transcripts including in-frame and out-of-frame species.
Endogenous MES donors are restricted to the 3' ends of exons 41, 44, 47 and 49.
Systemic antisense cocktail delivery achieved bodywide exons 45-55 skipping in mdx52 mice.

per_skip.skip: exons 54-57 (4 exons, 675 bp, del aa 2625-2849, junction ACAGAAACCAAG|GCCTTCAAGAGG)
per_skip.published_asos: Exon 54 and 55 PMOs as above (Ex54_Ac42_30-mer; Ex55_Ac0_30-mer, H55_8-28/11-31/14-34). Exon 56 and 57: no human ASO sequences retrieved. Exon 57 is explicitly documented as having been 'thus far unskippable' until rescued by double targeting of two sites within the exon with 2'-O-methyl phosphorothioate AONs (PMID 16753346); that paper's exon-57 AON identifiers were not retrieved. Mouse-transcript PPMOs skipping exons 56+57 exist (PMC7516190, sequences supplementary, not retrieved).
per_skip.coordinated_skipping: Partial positives at both ends but nothing spanning the block. (a) one AO to exon 54 removed 54+55 (PMC2835229); (b) exons 56+57 were skipped together in vivo but with one PPMO per exon (PMC7516190). No report of a single oligo producing 54-57. Searches tried: web '"Morpholino Oligomer-Induced Dystrophin Isoforms to Map the Functional Domains" exons 56 57 skipping single PMO' (confirmed cocktail, not single); PubMed co-skipping/double-skipping queries listed above (0 hits); Europe PMC 503.
per_skip.linked_or_multitarget: Exon 57 is the clearest case in the DMD literature where a two-arm/double-target approach converted an unskippable exon into a skippable one - the mechanistic rationale for the brogidirsen connected-sequence single molecule. If exon 57 must be included, a two-site strategy for exon 57 is near-mandatory.
per_skip.amenability: Mixed-to-poor. Exon 54 good; exon 55 kinetically unfavourable; exon 56 unmeasured but a natural acceptor (PMC5085753); exon 57 is a documented hard exon needing double targeting (PMID 16753346) and is also in the '5'Fast-3'Slow' flanking-intron class, with 5'-fast introns predicting low skippability (PMC10481881). There is no endogenous donor at exon 53/3' and no endogenous acceptor at exon 58... (the natural acceptors nearest this junction are exons 56 and 58, not 58's neighbour), so the 54|58 junction has no natural precedent. Functional quality of a del54-57 protein is poorly anchored because deletions downstream of exon 55 are rare (PMC7516190), though the related in-frame del56-57 isoform stabilized beta-dystroglycan and gave milder pathology in vivo.

findings.claim: Double targeting of two sites within one exon was effective for the 'thus far unskippable' exons 47 and 57.
The del56+57 dystrophin isoform showed higher expression, stabilized beta-dystroglycan and less severe pathology than del58+59.
Exon 57 is in the 5'Fast-3'Slow intron class; exons with slow 5'-introns are the more skippable ones.
Genomic DMD deletions downstream of exon 55 account for only ~7% of mutations (16% including intra-exonic).

per_skip.skip: exons 52-57 (6 exons, 1005 bp, del aa 2515-2849, junction ATCAAGCAGAAG|GCCTTCAAGAGG)
per_skip.published_asos: Exons 52-55 covered by validated PMOs (Ex52_Ac24 90.1%, Ex53_Ac26 75.2%, Ex54_Ac42 62.0%, Ex55_Ac0 120.4%; PMID 31416775). Exons 56 and 57: no human ASO sequence/efficiency retrieved; exon 57 documented as requiring double targeting (PMID 16753346).
per_skip.coordinated_skipping: None found. Only the sub-block events already cited (54+55 from one exon-54 AO; 56+57 from two PPMOs). Outer-exon-only targeting is specifically reported to fail at this length scale: attempts at exons 42-55 and 45-59 multi-skipping did not work (PMID 16753346). Searches as listed in the 52-55 and 54-57 blocks; Europe PMC 503 throughout.
per_skip.linked_or_multitarget: Cocktail precedent at this scale is real but is 10-11 separate oligos, not one linked molecule: mutation-tailored PMO sets removed 3, 8 or 10 exons in patient cells and skipped all 11 exons 45-55 in a humanized DMD mouse (PMID 31416775); long-term systemic Vivo-PMO cocktails in mdx52 (PMID 22869723; PMID 30171548). No linked multi-arm molecule spanning 6 exons found in any gene in my searches.
per_skip.amenability: This block contains both the best (52, 53, 55-lead-dependent) and the worst (57) exons of the region plus one unmeasured exon (56). Six simultaneous 100%-penetrant skips per transcript is the governing problem: the published cocktails were explicitly described as yielding mixed in-frame and out-of-frame intermediate species, and partial skipping here is non-productive because single-exon intermediates are out of frame. Endogenous precedent is adjacent but not identical: natural MES joins exon 49 to exon 56, i.e. nature skips 50-55 (a block in your enumeration), not 52-57 (PMC5085753).

findings.claim: Mutation-tailored PMO cocktails induced exons 45-55 skipping removing 3, 8 or 10 exons in immortalized DMD cells with dystrophin restoration by western blot.
In vivo skipping of the maximum 11 human DMD exons was demonstrated with the best cocktail set.
The exon 44-56-connected transcript is the natural counterpart of exons 45-55 skipping therapy; donors 41/44/47/49, acceptors 56/58/60/61.
Attempts to induce larger multiexon-skipping stretches such as exons 17-51, 42-55 and 45-59 were unsuccessful.

per_skip.skip: exons 53-58 (6 exons, 1008 bp, del aa 2554-2889, junction TTACGGATCGAA|AGCTGCCTCCTG)
per_skip.published_asos: Exons 53-55 have validated PMOs (Ex53_Ac9/Ac26, hEx53_Ac43; Ex54_Ac42; Ex55_Ac0, hEx55_Ac83 - PMID 31416775) plus clinical exon-53 ASOs golodirsen and viltolarsen (chemistry/delivery precedent only). Exon 53 ASO chemistry has also been explored as LNA/2'OMe and FRNA variants in human myoblasts (PMC10698779). Exons 56, 57, 58: no human ASO sequences retrieved; mouse PPMOs for 56+57 and 58+59 exist (PMC7516190).
per_skip.coordinated_skipping: None found for a single oligo over this block. Sub-block positives: exon-54 AO giving 54+55 (PMC2835229); 56+57 and 58+59 as PPMO pairs in mouse (PMC7516190). Searches: all queries listed in the preceding blocks plus 'U7 snRNA multiple exon skipping dystrophin single vector tandem antisense sequences' (PubMed 0 hits); Europe PMC 503 on every attempt.
per_skip.linked_or_multitarget: Same as above: 10-11-oligo cocktails for 45-55; two-AON outer-exon targeting works only up to ~7 exons (45-51) and failed beyond; brogidirsen is the only clinical single-molecule two-arm ASO and both arms sit in one exon.
per_skip.amenability: Attractive on natural-junction grounds: the 5' end of exon 58 is one of the four endogenous MES acceptors, so an exon-53-donor-to-exon-58-acceptor join uses a naturally used acceptor (PMC5085753) - but the matching endogenous donors are exons 41/44/47/49, not exon 53, so the exact 53|58 junction is still unprecedented naturally. Exon 53 is efficiently skipped and clinically de-risked as a target; exon 57 is the documented hard exon; exon 58 skipping in mouse produced a del58+59 isoform that performed worse functionally than del56+57 (PMC7516190), a caution for including 58. Six-exon penetrance problem identical to 52-57.

findings.claim: The 5' end of exon 58 is one of four acceptor sites used in endogenous multi-exon skipping in normal human muscle.
The del58+59 dystrophin isoform was less functional than del56+57 by expression, beta-dystroglycan stabilization and pathology.
Exon 53 skipping of the human DMD transcript has been assessed with LNA-modified, FRNA and LNA-2'OMe AONs in human myoblasts.
Exon 53 PMO Ex53_Ac9_30-mer GTTCTTGTACTTCATCCCACTGATTCTGAA, predicted 73.9%.

benchmarks_not_transferable: (1) Eteplirsen/golodirsen/viltolarsen/casimersen clinical dystrophin and skipping percentages are single-exon, single-oligo, naked-PMO numbers for exons 51/53/45; they say nothing about the yield of a 2-6 exon coordinated skip where every intermediate species is out of frame. (2) Brogidirsen's exon-44 skipping and dystrophin results are for a dual-arm oligo whose two arms sit inside ONE exon; it is architecture precedent only, not an efficiency expectation for arms placed in two different exons. (3) The 120.4% 'predicted skipping' for Ex55_Ac0_30-mer and all other numbers from the 45-55 cocktail paper are predictive-tool/in-vitro screen values, not protein-level efficacy. (4) Exons 45-55 cocktail efficacy in mdx52 and hDMD mice reflects a different, naturally-permissive junction (endogenous exon 44-56 joining) and does not transfer to 54-55, 55-56, 52-55, 54-57, 52-57 or 53-58. (5) mdx exon-23 PPMO potency, and the mouse 56+57 / 58+59 in vivo results, are mouse-transcript data at mouse splice sites; exon numbering coincidence does not imply human exon 56/57 amenability. (6) Endogenous MES abundance (~600-fold below full-length) is a permissiveness signal, not a therapeutic baseline.
proposed_designs: Lead: 2-PMO/PPMO cocktail for exons 54-55 - exon-54 arm at Ex54_Ac42 region, exon-55 arm at nt 11-31 (H55_11-31 / Ex55_Ac0), fewest exons, fewest aa lost.
Single-oligo probe: re-test an exon-54-only AO (Ex54_Ac42 region, 25-31mer) for the reported 54+55 co-skip; accept only if 54-alone out-of-frame product is minor.
Dual-arm connected-sequence single molecule (brogidirsen architecture): one PMO linking an exon-54 acceptor-region arm to an exon-55 5'-end arm.
Fallback if exon 54 resists: 2-oligo exons 55-56 cocktail, exploiting exon 56's natural MES acceptor; needs de novo exon-56 ASO walk.
